definitionZh: 边框-端宽 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内端边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽,边框-右宽,边框-下宽,或边框-左宽的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.
sourceDefinition: The border-inline-end-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
